question: The 'kathaks' (of a dance form called Kathak), were originally a caste of ________ in temples of North India.
solution:
The correct answer is __story tellers.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'kathaks' (of a dance form called Kathak), were originally a caste of **story tellers** in temples of North India.
 
• ​The term kathak is derived from katha, a word used in Sanskrit and other languages for story.
 
• The kathaks were originally a caste of story-tellers in temples of north India, who embellished their performances with gestures and songs.
 
• Kathak began evolving into a distinct mode of dance in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries with the spread of the bhakti movement.
